name: Liam Tremblay
bio:
Liam grew up around racing, his family owning a small karting track just outside Montreal. He always had a knack for understanding people and their motivations. While he wasn't the best driver, he noticed how important team dynamics were to success on the track. This led him to pursue a career in HR, initially in general industry before making the leap to motorsport.

Liam believes in building a strong and supportive team environment where everyone feels valued and has the opportunity to excel. He's particularly adept at identifying talent and matching individuals with roles that best suit their skills and personality. His methodical approach ensures that all HR processes are fair and compliant.

What sets Liam apart is his understanding of the unique pressures and demands of the motorsport world. He knows how to find people who can thrive in this high-stakes environment and how to create a culture that fosters both performance and well-being. He's a fast learner who is dedicated to innovation and implementing new strategies to ensure a competitive advantage.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly parted on the side
physical.description: Liam is of average height with a slightly athletic build.

quirks: Always has a motivational quote displayed on his desk.
Prefers to conduct interviews while walking around the office.
Keeps a small collection of vintage racing posters.
